SELECT FROM access_log
AND (access_time, id) < (#{cursorAccessTime}, #{cursorId})
AND username LIKE '%' || #{username} || '%' AND client_ip LIKE '%' || #{clientIp} || '%' AND (request_uri LIKE '%' || #{requestUri} || '%' OR endpoint_template LIKE '%' || #{requestUri} || '%') AND method = #{method} AND response_status LIKE #{responseStatus} || '%' AND access_time >= CAST(#{startTime} AS timestamp) AND access_time <= CAST(#{endTime} AS timestamp)
ORDER BY access_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM access_log
AND username LIKE '%' || #{username} || '%' AND client_ip LIKE '%' || #{clientIp} || '%' AND (request_uri LIKE '%' || #{requestUri} || '%' OR endpoint_template LIKE '%' || #{requestUri} || '%') AND method = #{method} AND response_status LIKE #{responseStatus} || '%' AND access_time >= CAST(#{startTime} AS timestamp) AND access_time <= CAST(#{endTime} AS timestamp)

WITH filtered AS ( SELECT FROM access_log
ORDER BY access_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset} ), identifiers AS ( SELECT filtered.*, CASE WHEN auditTarget LIKE 'sjh:%' THEN NULL WHEN POSITION(':' IN auditTarget) > 0 THEN SUBSTRING(auditTarget, 1, POSITION(':' IN auditTarget) - 1) WHEN auditTarget IS NULL OR auditTarget = '' OR auditTarget = 'search' THEN NULL ELSE auditTarget END AS bah, CASE WHEN auditTarget LIKE 'sjh:%' THEN SUBSTRING(auditTarget FROM 5) WHEN POSITION(':' IN auditTarget) > 0 THEN SUBSTRING(auditTarget, POSITION(':' IN auditTarget) + 1) ELSE NULL END AS sjh FROM filtered ) SELECT identifiers.*, ( SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(stat.patientid), '') FROM mr_statistics stat WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(stat.patientid), '') IS NOT NULL AND ( (identifiers.bah IS NOT NULL AND stat.bah = identifiers.bah AND (identifiers.sjh IS NULL OR identifiers.sjh = '' OR stat.sjh = identifiers.sjh)) OR (identifiers.bah IS NULL AND identifiers.sjh IS NOT NULL AND stat.sjh = identifiers.sjh) ) ORDER BY stat.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS patientId FROM identifiers ORDER BY accessTime DESC, id DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "totalAccesses", COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(username), '')) AS "uniqueUsers", COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(audit_target), '')) AS "uniqueTargets", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN response_status LIKE '4%' OR response_status LIKE '5%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "abnormalAccesses", ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(execute_time), 0), 1) AS "averageDurationMs" FROM access_log

SELECT recent.audit_date AS "date", recent.access_count AS "count" FROM ( SELECT CAST(access_time AS DATE) AS audit_date, COUNT(*) AS access_count FROM access_log AND access_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CAST(access_time AS DATE) ORDER BY audit_date DESC LIMIT 14 ) recent ORDER BY recent.audit_date ASC

SELECT actions.label AS "label", COUNT(filtered.audit_action) AS "count" FROM ( SELECT 'LIST' AS label UNION ALL SELECT 'DOWNLOAD' UNION ALL SELECT 'VIEW_IMAGE' UNION ALL SELECT 'VIEW_OSS_IMAGE' ) actions LEFT JOIN ( SELECT audit_action FROM access_log
) filtered ON filtered.audit_action = actions.label GROUP BY actions.label ORDER BY COUNT(filtered.audit_action) DESC, actions.label ASC
SELECT username AS "label", COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM access_log AND NULLIF(TRIM(username), '') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY username ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, username ASC LIMIT 5

SELECT audit_target AS "label", COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM access_log AND NULLIF(TRIM(audit_target), '') IS NOT NULL AND audit_target != 'search' GROUP BY audit_target ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, audit_target ASC LIMIT 10
